additional_info.subject: ID0445819-DC/Si-D/TR-[MP / PN 170001123] There is no charging session on DC2 CRM:02678000218
additional_info.body:
Hi Emre-abi, good afternoon. I hope you are doing well.
I checked the charging sessions and it seems like the reading is incorrect:
Please check the following circuit:
Make sure XD10.3 is not loose, it's those orange connectors that get loose a lot. Otherwise, please trial a charging session and check the 2...10V output from the TF2 and see if it matches the value reading on the converter and follow until the KF7.
I recommend bringing a spare TF2 and KF7 to site. If you don't have KF7 that is fine since it's a component hardly replaced.
I will send to RC-TR queue, if you need on-site support please schedule with at least 2 days in advance to prepare.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco
